description: User request: in People, mark one person as 'me' (one at a time, settings.selfPersonId). A Settings toggle, off by default (hideOwnSpeechOnGlasses), removes caption lines attributed to that person from the glasses prompter. Only accepted/confirmed attributions count, not 'Name?' candidates, so another speaker's captions aren't hidden on a weak match.
title: Hide my own speech on the glasses: mark a person as me, off-by-default toggle
